BiblicalUsage: Seorim is named once, in the courses of the priests. The third lot fell to Harim, the fourth to Seorim, in the order David set for the sons of Aaron.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even the fourth course has its place in the record, because no man's service in God's house is too small to be named.
